name: Image
purpose: Provide styled resilient media with Atom loading/fallback behavior, sizing recipes, and accessible image semantics.
useWhen: A product image, brand asset, illustration, or content image needs Brick sizing, fit, radius, loading, or fallback presentation.

avoidWhen.condition: A framework optimizer provides a required measured optimization Brick does not expose.
avoidWhen.useInstead: a documented Image adapter that preserves semantics and reports the capability gap

composition: Compose Image.Content and optional Image.Fallback inside Image.Root; use Brick Stack or layout components around it rather than wrapper spans for alignment.

rules.statement: Use Brick Image for ordinary interface media; document any native or framework image fallback and the missing capability.
Provide meaningful alt text, or alt="" for a decorative image.
Reserve dimensions or aspect ratio to prevent layout shift.
Load styles.css or core.css plus image.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using next/image automatically, wrapping Image in spans for ordinary alignment, or duplicating the caption in alt text.
commonMistakes.correction: Start with Brick Image, use Brick layout components, and adapt only for a measured missing optimizer capability.

validation: Check loaded, loading, error, cached, responsive size, crop, layout shift, alt text, contrast of fallback content, and RTL where relevant.
Confirm CSS and any adapter report are complete.
